authentication_type.description: The authentication options with which to log in. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_AUTHENTICATION_TYPE` environment variable will be used. Valid values are: `native`, `cleartext`. The default is `native`.

connect_timeout.description: The timeout (in seconds) for establishing a connection. The default is `30`.

endpoint.description: The endpoint (IP address or hostname) of the RDS instance to which the provider will connect. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_ENDPOINT` environment variable will be used.

password.description: The password of the MySQL user with which to authenticate. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_PASSWORD` environment variable will be used.

port.description: The TCP port of the RDS instance to which the provider will connect. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_PORT`environment variable or the default of `3306` will be used.

tls.description: The TLS setting with which to connect. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_TLS_CONFIG` environment variable will be used. Valid values are: `true`, `false`, `skip-verify`.

username.description: The username of the MySQL user with which to authenticate. If not provided, the value of the `MYSQL_USERNAME` environment variable will be used.

name.description: The setting name. Only settings supported by RDS/Aurora will be allowed. Others will cause an error during `plan` or `apply`.

value.description: The value for the setting. _**NOTE:** For `binlog retention hours`, the value `0` will be converted to `NULL`, as required by `mysql.rds_set_configuration()`._

block.description: An individual RDS MySQL configuration setting.

setting.description: An individual RDS MySQL configuration setting.
